1,201 likes, 34 comments - hercircleofficial on October 15, 2026: "What does it take to make space for yourself in a world that expects you to keep showing up? And how much do the values we grow up with shape the choices we make as adults?

For Dia Mirza Rekhi, the answers lie in the experiences that have shaped her perspective. From renegotiating the terms of her work after a life-changing encounter with a forest to growing up with a mother and a grandmother who embodied independence, generosity and equality, Dia reflects on the moments that continue to guide her. 

In conversation with Tanya Chaitanya for 𝘏𝘦𝘳 𝘊𝘪𝘳𝘤𝘭𝘦 𝘖𝘳𝘪𝘨𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴, she speaks about finding balance, navigating the expectations placed on women and recognising the values that stay with us long after childhood.

To watch the full interview, visit Hercircle.in 

Credits

CEO & Editor-in-Chief: Tanya Chaitanya @tanyachaitanya27 

Head - Marketing & Comms: Iona Chatterjee @ionachatterjee 

Art Director & Video Editor: Sameer More @sambeingg 

Videographer: Harish Iyer @iyerishh 

Assistant Videographer: Yash Bedi @yashu.bedi_ 

On-location Support: Nikita Bajaj @missbajaj_25 

#HerCircleOriginals #HerCircle #HerCircleCommunity #DiaMirza #SustainableLife".
